name: University of Cambridge
typicalOffer: A*A*A, Mathematics plus 2 other science or mathematics subjects (Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and for A level only Further Mathematics); some Colleges/first-year options need specific sciences
notes: Natural Sciences (Physical) or Mathematics Tripos both allow crossover; DAMTP does mathematical physics; very strong tradition in mathematical physics

name: University of Edinburgh
typicalOffer: A*A*A*-A*AB, including Mathematics at A* and Physics at B (Further Mathematics preferred)
notes: 4-year MPhys Mathematics and Physics; joint between Physics and Mathematics; Scottish 4-year Honours; Higgs Centre; strong in mathematical methods of physics

name: University of Warwick
typicalOffer: A*AA, including A* in Mathematics, A in Further Mathematics and A in Physics
notes: 4-year MMath/MPhys Mathematics and Physics; joint programme between Warwick Maths and Physics; strong in mathematical physics and theoretical mechanics

name: University of Bristol
typicalOffer: A*A*A, including A* in Maths and A in Physics (or A*A in Maths and Further Maths, and A in Physics, with A*AA)
notes: 4-year MSci Mathematics and Physics; joint programme; Bristol Quantum Information Institute; strong in mathematical methods, QM and mathematical physics

name: Durham University
typicalOffer: A*A*A, including Physics, Mathematics and Further Mathematics at A level, or A*A* in Physics and Mathematics plus A in AS Further Mathematics for students unable to take A level Further Maths
notes: 4-year MMath/MPhys Mathematics and Physics; joint delivery; Durham's IPPP and Mathematics Department collaborate closely; strong in quantum mechanics and geometry

name: University of Nottingham
typicalOffer: A*AA, Including AA in A level maths and physics
notes: No course under the listed title; this is the university’s closest course in the subject.

name: University of Southampton
typicalOffer: AAA, including Mathematics and Physics (grade A)
notes: No course under the listed title; this is the university’s closest course in the subject.

name: University of Glasgow
typicalOffer: AAB, A-level Mathematics at A and A-level Physics at A/B
notes: 4-year MPhys/MMath Mathematics and Physics; joint delivery; Scottish 4-year Honours; strong in gravitational waves and quantum computing; good graduate employment

name: University of York
notes: 4-year MMath/MPhys Mathematics and Physics; York Centre for Quantum Technologies; strong mathematical physics and quantum information; good for those keen on both disciplines
